mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT recover from their recent troughs, more weekday trips and errand chaining will raise retail and recreation visits within four weeks. The mechanism fails if these mobility series stay depressed while RETAIL_REC still rises.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell to -22.9 at t-1w then improved to -15.9 at t-0w; TRANSIT improved from -25.0 to -20.7
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 4-week mean even when WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in PARKS mobility signals substitution away from outdoor leisure toward indoor retail venues, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next one to two weeks. This fails if PARKS falls but RETAIL_REC does not respond upward.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -10 after a week above -5
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -1.7 at t-1w to -10.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 14 days after PARKS crosses below -10 from near-zero levels.

mechanism_narrative: When residential presence stays elevated while transit remains suppressed, discretionary shopping shifts to neighborhood retail and local services, keeping RETAIL_REC higher than its recent average over four weeks. The claim fails if residential and transit move together in the same direction without supporting retail gains.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed above baseline at 7.7-9.4 while TRANSIT stayed around -20 to -25
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to the last 4 weeks despite RESIDENTIAL staying above 7 and TRANSIT staying below -20 for most weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continued rebound in GROCERY_PHARM indicates resumed routine out-of-home activity that spills over into nearby retail and recreation within one week. The mechanism fails if grocery mobility rises while retail and recreation remains unchanged or weaker.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above 2 after being near 0
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was 1.0 at t-0w after being 2.7-3.0 earlier
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM rises back above 2 percent from near-baseline levels.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES weakens while RESIDENTIAL strengthens, people spend more time at home and defer discretionary shopping trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks. This fails if work mobility falls without a corresponding rise in residential time.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped from -22.9 to -15.9 while RESIDENTIAL stayed positive at 7.7-9.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is higher over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying depressed and RESIDENTIAL staying elevated.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS from deeply negative values is a short-lived weather or seasonality signal that pulls demand away from indoor retail venues, reducing RETAIL_REC within two weeks. The hypothesis fails if PARKS recovers but retail does not weaken.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -5 after being below -15
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -18.3 and -14.4 to -1.7 before easing to -10.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after PARKS rebounds from below -15 to above -5.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains below -20 and WORKPLACES stays below -15 together, the city is still in a constrained movement regime that suppresses retail foot traffic over the next four weeks. The claim fails if retail rises while both movement proxies stay weak.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -20 and WORKPLACES below -15 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT remained between -25.0 and -20.7; WORKPLACES remained between -22.9 and -15.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC exceeds the prior 4-week mean even though TRANSIT stays below -20 and WORKPLACES stays below -15 for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week improvement in TRANSIT after a recent slump produces immediate but temporary retail recovery as commuters resume stop-in shopping, increasing RETAIL_REC over the next week. It fails if transit improves yet retail remains below its recent average.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 3 points week-on-week after a trough
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -25.0 at t-1w to -20.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 7 days after a week-on-week TRANSIT gain of 3 points or more.
